prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” roofing company for everyone — the right contractor depends on your roof type, budget, warranty priorities, and whether you need insurance-claim help. I can help you find the best fit, but first here are practical ways to identify a top Dallas roofer and what to check.

What to look for
- Manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred). These mean the crew is trained and can offer stronger warranties.  
- Local reputation: high ratings and recent positive reviews on Google, Angi, Yelp, and the BBB (look for an A or A+ rating).  
- Insurance and registration: verify general liability and workers’ comp; confirm any required Dallas/city registration or permits. (Texas has no single statewide roofing license, so local checks and credentials matter.)  
- Written, itemized estimate: roof square footage, materials, underlayment, vents, flashing, tear-off vs. overlay, disposal, permit cost, timeline.  
- Warranties: manufacturer (shingle) warranty and a workmanship warranty from the contractor; get both in writing.  
- References and verifiable recent jobs: ask for local references and photos you can check.  
- Clear contract terms: payment schedule (avoid large upfront sums), cleanup, lien releases on final payment, start/end dates.  
- Storm-chaser warning signs: avoid high-pressure sales, large upfront payments, or contractors who can’t provide a local address or references.

How to choose
- Get 3–4 detailed, comparable quotes.  
- Prefer a company with manufacturer certification and good local references even if their price isn’t the lowest.  
- Verify permits and confirm they’ll handle inspections/permit pulls.  
- Check for red flags (no proof of insurance, out-of-state PO box only, poor communication).

Where to find candidates
- Search contractors certified by GAF/CertainTeed/Owens Corning in Dallas.  
- Check Google Business listings, BBB, Angi, and local Facebook community groups for recent homeowner experiences.  
- Ask neighbors who’ve had recent roof work — see the roof and ask about their experience.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend highly rated Dallas-area roofers (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood), or  
- Draft an email/list of questions for you to send to contractors, or  
- Walk you through comparing 3 estimates if you paste them here.

Which would you like me to do next?
